title: Buggy, error-ridden, not worth it
text: Buggy, error-ridden, not worth it. Within two weeks, the timer began to fail. It would beep at the halfway point and not at all at the end. Then the set time started having issues. One example- I set the timer for 30 minutes. When I checked on it close to when time was up, the timer now said 19 hours & 21 minutes. Changing the battery did not help, the issues continued. I don't know if I bought a dud but I am not trying again with this brand. It's going in the trash and I will buy something else. Very disappointed.
